Definition: Cheber, the name of a Kenite and of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Heber names two different men, and they must not be folded into one. Heber the Kenite pitches his tent by Kedesh, and Sisera flees to the tent of Jael his wife; Heber the son of Beriah is a son of Asher who goes down into Egypt with Jacob.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the two Hebers straight, and so must I: one is the Kenite whose tent ends Sisera's flight, and the other is a son of Asher in the house of Jacob.
RelatedPeople: Heber, the Kenite; Heber, Son of Beriah; Jael
